summary_en: This study tests two radiation schedules given as a bridge before CAR T-cell or bispecific antibody therapy in adults with relapsed or refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. Each patient's tumor is split, so one part gets once-daily radiation and the other part gets twice-daily radiation, with both areas treated daily; the total length of treatment is not stated. The study measures feasibility and safety, and the phase is not applicable (NA).
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa dos esquemas de radioterapia usados como puente antes de la terapia con células CAR T o anticuerpos biespecíficos en adultos con linfoma difuso de células B grandes recidivante o refractario. Cada tumor se divide: una parte recibe radioterapia una vez al día y la otra parte recibe radioterapia dos veces al día, y ambas áreas se tratan diariamente; la duración total no se indica. El estudio mide la factibilidad y la seguridad, y la fase no aplica (NA).
who_for: Confirmed relapsed or refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with a planned CAR T or bispecific antibody therapy at Yale New Haven Hospital.
Able to attend once or twice daily weekday radiation therapy without radiotherapy contraindications.
Women of childbearing potential need a negative pregnancy test and must agree to effective pregnancy precautions.
not_for: Prior research radiation exposure in the past year that would exceed FDA annual limits.
Unable to safely receive the FDG PET tracer.
Any condition that the investigator judges would interfere with participation or pose significant risk.
Not expected to benefit from bridging radiotherapy, unable to have twice daily radiotherapy, or has a radiation contraindication.
